top_signals.title: Healey’s grid pledge faces test as data centre pipeline stalls
top_signals.summary: John Healey’s Budget pledge to fast-track electricity connections for British data centres faces an immediate test, as new research shows only 13 per cent of planned capacity is under construction. top_signals.title: Poundland close to collapse as it files notice to appoint administrators
top_signals.summary: Poundland is teetering on the edge of collapse after its directors filed a notice of intent to appoint administrators, in a move that would put thousands of jobs at risk. The company made the filing to the High Court on Thursday, suggesting that administrators could be formally called in to take control of the business [...]
